name: raghub-smoke-hybrid
description: Preregistered exact-byte smoke corpus for three-way FTS, Dense, and Hybrid RRF comparison. Twenty fixed queries cover exact identifiers, semantic paraphrases, Chinese-English retrieval, near-duplicate distractors, ACL filtering, and tenant isolation. It is local smoke evidence, not a production benchmark.

documents.title: Webhook Failure Catalog
documents.content:
# Webhook failure QLZ-739

Error QLZ-739 means the callback dispatcher rejected a signed request because its timestamp was more than 300 seconds behind server time. Synchronize the sender clock before retrying the callback.

documents.title: Torque Adapter Inventory
documents.content:
# Inventory item SKU-K4X-991

SKU-K4X-991 is the graphite left-handed torque adapter. Replacement units are stored in aisle seven, bin C-14.

documents.title: Replay Timing Configuration
documents.content:
# Replay gap setting

The configuration key max_replay_gap_ms limits the permitted gap between replayed event timestamps. The Acme production value is 45000 milliseconds.

documents.title: Retrieval Trace Header
documents.content:
# Retrieval diagnostics

Send the HTTP request header X-RagHub-Trace with value stages to include retrieval-stage diagnostics in the response. Do not enable it for ordinary client traffic.

documents.title: Membership Renewal Policy
documents.content:
# Ending automatic renewal

Disable automatic renewal in billing settings to prevent the next charge. Membership benefits remain active until the final day of the already-paid period.

documents.title: Database Backup Window
documents.content:
# Point-in-time recovery

Database backups are retained for forty-five days. Operations can recover records deleted within that retention window, but older recovery points are unavailable.

documents.title: Blue-Green Release Procedure
documents.content:
# Switching production without downtime

Deploy the release to the idle green environment, complete health checks, and then move the production router from blue to green. Keep blue available for immediate rollback.

documents.title: Invoice Legal Address Changes
documents.content:
# Correcting company details

Update the legal company address in the billing profile before the invoice is issued. After issuance, request a credit note and replacement invoice from finance support.

documents.title: Visitor Umbrella Service
documents.content:
# Rain supplies for visitors

Visitors may borrow a blue umbrella from the ground-floor reception desk. Return it at the west entrance before the building closes.

documents.title: 差旅票据提交时限
documents.content:
# 酒店票据报销

员工应在出差返程后的十个自然日内提交酒店住宿票据。超过期限时，需要直属经理书面批准后才能补交。

documents.title: Parental Leave Notice
documents.content:
# Planning parental leave

A parent should notify People Operations at least thirty calendar days before the expected leave start date. An unexpected early birth can be reported as soon as practical.

documents.title: Atlas Production Rotation
documents.content:
# Project Atlas production on-call

The production rotation sends incident webhooks to https://ops.acme.test/hooks/atlas-prod. Escalations go to the primary platform engineer.

documents.title: Atlas Staging Rotation
documents.content:
# Project Atlas staging on-call

The staging rotation sends test webhooks to https://ops.acme.test/hooks/atlas-stage. Notifications go to the platform test channel.

documents.title: Alpine Connector Version 2
documents.content:
# Current Alpine connector

Alpine connector version 2 authenticates with OAuth device flow at /oauth/device/code. Basic authentication is not supported by the current connector.

documents.title: Alpine Connector Legacy
documents.content:
# Legacy Alpine connector

Alpine connector version 1 authenticated with a basic username and password at /api/login. This retired flow remains documented only for migration investigations.

documents.title: Administrative Audit Log Retention
documents.content:
# Administrative audit records

Administrative audit logs record policy and permission changes. They are retained for four hundred days for compliance investigations.

documents.title: Gateway Access Log Retention
documents.content:
# Gateway access records

Gateway access logs record ordinary HTTP requests. They are retained for thirty days for operational troubleshooting.

documents.title: Nebula Restricted Release Control
documents.content:
# Project Nebula restricted release control

The emergency production-unlock phrase is VIOLET-ANCHOR. Only the release commander may use it during an approved incident.

documents.title: Nebula Release Escalation
documents.content:
# Project Nebula release help

Engineers without restricted release-control access must contact the release commander. They must not attempt the emergency production unlock themselves.

documents.title: Restricted Payroll Export Calendar
documents.content:
# Restricted payroll export

The payroll export is frozen on January 14 at 18:00 UTC. Only payroll controller Carol may access the export calendar and release checklist.

documents.title: Payroll Export Access Requests
documents.content:
# Requesting payroll export assistance

Employees without payroll-controller access should open a confidential finance-support request. Finance will provide an approved status update without exposing the restricted export calendar.

documents.title: Acme Project Aurora Routing
documents.content:
# Project Aurora routing

For Acme, the internal routing codename for Project Aurora is Maple, and the owning group is warehouse operations.

documents.title: Globex Project Aurora Routing
documents.content:
# Project Aurora routing

For Globex, the internal routing codename for Project Aurora is Topaz, and the owning group is field research.

documents.title: Acme Mercury Billing Region
documents.content:
# Project Mercury billing location

Acme processes Project Mercury invoices in the eu-west-3 billing region. The finance owner is the Dublin operations team.

documents.title: Globex Mercury Billing Region
documents.content:
# Project Mercury billing location

Globex processes Project Mercury invoices in the us-central-2 billing region. The finance owner is the Chicago research team.
